title.narrative: Support for the Justice Reform Support Program (PARJ) in Mauritania

description.narrative:
The European Union has maintained support measures for the judicial sector through the Justice Reform Support Program (PARJ) in Mauriania. The general objective of PARJ is to contribute to improving the rule of law, by improving governance and protecting human rights.

The specific objectives of the EU Program are: (1) the in-depth reform of the Mauritanian judicial and penitentiary system and (2) the promotion of independent, credible, gender-sensitive and citizen-friendly justice.

Four areas of intervention are expected from the Program: 1) The steering capacities of the Ministry of Justice and the implementation of the sectoral policy are strengthened, 2) The functioning of the penal and penitentiary chain is improved, 3) The access to Justice is improved and 4) Judicial and prison infrastructures are strengthened.

UNOPS supports the project through infrastructure and rehabilitation of courts and judicial buildings of Mauritania in Aleg, Boutilimit and Nouakchott.
